newsitem.title: UK: Daimler-Benz unit sets exchangeable notes.
newsitem.headline: Daimler-Benz unit sets exchangeable notes.

text.p: Daimler-Benz Finanz (Luxembourg) AG is to issue a two-tranche exhangeable note into common shares of Cap Gemini S.A.. shares, lead manager Goldman Sachs said Wednesday.

The notes will be guaranteed by Daimler-Benz AG and consist of a 2.25 million French franc tranche and a $400 million tranche. Both tranches have a maturity of January 1, 2002 unless earlier exchanged or redeemed and an offering price of par.
The French franc tranche has an indicative coupon of 3.50 percent, and an exchange ratio of one share per French franc note, whilst the dollar tranche has an indicative coupon of 5.0 percent.
Common to both tranches is a 13 percent greenshoe option and an indicative exchange premium of 14-18 percent. There is a hard non-call untill January 1, 2000 and absolute cash call thereafter.
The notes will be listed in Luxembourg.
